tasks.title: Move workflow session visibility behind a workflow-layer helper
tasks.description: Split the runtime observer contract from the workflow visibility adapter. Keep `SessionObserver`, `SessionContext`, `SessionState`, and `ToolCallEvent` in agent-runtime, move `WorkflowSessionObserver` to a workflow/service visibility module, and add a `createWorkflowSessionObservers` helper that constructs the observer from EventBus, workflow log, session stream log, coder session repo, throttle, stage, title, and task metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: `packages/cli/src/agent-runtime/session-observer.ts` exports only runtime observer contracts and no EventBus or DB repo imports

`WorkflowSessionObserver` exists outside `packages/cli/src/agent-runtime/` and preserves current workflow_log, session_stream_log, coder_session, coder_text_chunk, coder_tool_call, and coder_session_started behavior
A workflow/service-layer helper creates `SessionObserver[]` from visibility dependencies and optional extra observers
Existing behavior is preserved while the helper is introduced
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This task produces the visibility adapter boundary consumed by later tasks. Temporary imports from AgentSession to the moved observer are acceptable only until T-002 removes runtime construction.

tasks.title: Make AgentSession accept observers only
tasks.description: Remove workflow visibility dependencies from `AgentSessionOptions` and from `agent-runtime/agent-session.ts`. `AgentSession` should receive observer instances through `observers`, publish lifecycle and ACP-derived events to them, and no longer construct or import `WorkflowSessionObserver`.
acceptanceCriteria: `AgentSessionOptions` contains no `EventBus`, `WorkflowLogRepo`, `SessionStreamLogRepo`, or `CoderSessionRepo` types
`agent-runtime/agent-session.ts` does not import `WorkflowSessionObserver` or any workflow/db/service visibility module
`AgentSession` still emits `onSessionStart`, `onTextChunk`, `onToolCall`, `onSessionEvent`, `onRawNotification`, and `onStateChange` to supplied observers
Stable `ToolCallEvent.toolCallId` generation is owned by runtime code and no longer calls a workflow observer method
`withSession` still closes sessions in `finally`
Abort and timeout paths still cancel ACP, run optional `onBeforeKill`, clean up the process, and return a failed `AcpSessionResult`
Model override still calls ACP session config after session creation, and model-set failure remains warning/degraded behavior
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do not replace workflow dependencies with a generic visibility option bag. Keep runtime options limited to session/runtime metadata plus observers.

tasks.title: Migrate workflow and service consumers to explicit observers
tasks.description: Update every AgentSession consumer to construct workflow visibility observers explicitly or via the helper from T-001. Preserve Plan and Check multi-round sessions by creating one `AgentSession` per stage and passing raw-notification bridge observers for `plan_session_update` events instead of using `onSessionUpdate` in runtime options.
acceptanceCriteria: `WorkflowEngine`, `StageContext`, `PlanStageRunner`, `CheckStageRunner`, `BuildStageRunner`, checks, `RalphExecutor`, `SkillService`, `ExploreAcpService`, `ConflictResolution`, `AgentRunnerService`, and server entry points no longer pass EventBus or DB repos through `AgentSessionOptions`
Plan stage still reuses one `AgentSession` across proposal, specs, design, tasks, self-review, and retry prompts
Check stage still reuses one `AgentSession` across review and review-self-check prompts
Plan/Check raw ACP notifications still emit `plan_session_update` with round metadata, and EventBus failures remain fire-and-forget
Build, check auto-fix, Explore, Skill, and conflict-resolution sessions still create visibility observers when progress/logging is required
`coder_text_chunk`, `coder_tool_call`, `coder_session_started`, workflow log, session stream log, and coder session status behavior remains visible through observers
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This is the consumer migration task. Prefer the helper for common observer construction and small inline observers only for Plan/Check raw notification bridges.

tasks.title: Remove remaining runtime imports of workflow visibility layers
tasks.description: Audit the whole agent-runtime package after consumer migration and remove remaining imports of workflow, DB repo, EventBus, or service visibility modules. Make `SessionStateMachine` runtime-only if necessary so coder_session persistence is performed through observers rather than direct runtime DB attachment.
acceptanceCriteria: No file under `packages/cli/src/agent-runtime/` imports from `../db/`, `../workflow/`, or `../services/event-bus`
`SessionStateMachine` remains usable as a runtime state validator without depending on `CoderSessionRepo`
Terminal state changes are still delivered to observers so `WorkflowSessionObserver` can update `coder_session.status`
No duplicate coder_session status persistence path remains between runtime state machine and workflow observer
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This task closes the package-level boundary, not just the `agent-session.ts` boundary.

tasks.title: Add regression tests for observer-driven session visibility
tasks.description: Add or update tests that prove visibility still flows through observers after the boundary cleanup. Cover text chunks, tool calls with stable IDs and full payloads, coder_session lifecycle status, session stream logs, Plan/Check raw notification bridges, and the cleaned `AgentSessionOptions` shape.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests fail if `AgentSessionOptions` reintroduces EventBus or DB repo fields
Tests verify `coder_text_chunk` and `coder_tool_call` events are emitted via observers with issue-number fallback and stable `toolCallId`
Tests verify session_stream_log and workflow_log writes still happen through `WorkflowSessionObserver`
Tests verify coder_session status updates on completed, failed, timeout, and cancelled state changes
Tests verify Plan/Check raw notification observers emit `plan_session_update` without creating a new session per prompt
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer focused tests around the runtime boundary and observer behavior rather than broad E2E-only coverage.

tasks.title: Add cleanup and model override regression coverage
tasks.description: Add targeted tests for lifecycle behavior that must not regress during the boundary cleanup. Cover `withSession` finally cleanup, abort and timeout cancel/cleanup/onBeforeKill behavior, spawn/init failure cleanup, and ACP model override success and degraded failure paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests verify `withSession` calls `close()` in a `finally` path when execution succeeds or fails
Tests verify abort path attempts ACP cancel, runs `onBeforeKill`, cleans up the process, and returns `success: false` with a user-visible stopped message
Tests verify timeout path attempts ACP cancel, runs `onBeforeKill`, cleans up the process, emits terminal state, and returns a timeout failure result
Tests verify model override is sent after session creation when configured
Tests verify model-set failure logs/degrades without failing session creation
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: These tests protect the highest-risk non-visibility behavior: no zombie ACP processes and no silent model override regression.

tasks.title: Extract a runtime-only ACP connection driver if it reduces AgentSession responsibility
tasks.description: Evaluate `AgentSession` after boundary cleanup and extract a small runtime-only ACP driver if protocol wiring still obscures the session domain logic. The driver may own `ClientSideConnection`, protocol version, permission defaults, initialize/newSession/prompt/cancel/config calls, and ACP notification wiring, but it must not own workflow, issue, DB, EventBus, or visibility policy.
acceptanceCriteria: If extracted, the ACP driver imports no workflow, DB, EventBus, service visibility, issue, or stage modules
If extracted, `AgentSession` delegates ACP protocol calls while keeping create, execute, cancel, close, state, output aggregation, timeout/abort policy, and observer dispatch understandable
If not extracted, `AgentSession` remains free of workflow visibility dependencies and an implementation note in the task notes or PR summary explains why extraction would be a shallow pass-through
All agent-runtime tests pass after the decision
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do not create a large protocol abstraction just to reduce line count. This task is complete if the agent makes and documents the extraction decision and keeps tests green.

tasks.title: Run full verification for agent session flows
tasks.description: Run the project build and full test suite after all runtime, observer, consumer, and optional ACP-driver changes. Fix any regressions that violate Plan, Build, Check, Explore, Skill, conflict-resolution, visibility, cleanup, or model override behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: `cd packages/cli && npm run build` succeeds
`cd packages/cli && npm test` succeeds
Search confirms `AgentSessionOptions` has no EventBus or DB repo fields
Search confirms `agent-runtime/agent-session.ts` does not import `WorkflowSessionObserver`
Search confirms `packages/cli/src/agent-runtime/` has no workflow/db/EventBus visibility imports
Search confirms Plan and Check runners still call `AgentSession.create()` once per multi-round stage and use multiple `execute()` calls
No frontend API shape, SSE event name, or DB schema change is introduced
tasks.output: verification result in task run logs
tasks.notes: Final verification task. It intentionally depends on the optional ACP-driver decision so the final graph remains linear and verifiable.
